scripts.build: prisma generate && rm -rf .open-next .next && opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && node scripts/patch-cf-worker-cron.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const d='.open-next/assets';if(!fs.existsSync(d))process.exit(0);const rm=[];function walk(p){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(p)){const fp=path.join(p,f);const s=fs.statSync(fp);if(s.isDirectory())walk(fp);else if(f.endsWith('.mp4')||f.endsWith('.mov')||f.endsWith('.apk')||f.endsWith('.webm')){if(s.size>10*1024*1024||f==='demo-tutorial.mp4'){rm.push(fp);fs.unlinkSync(fp)}}}}walk(d);if(rm.length)console.log('🗑 Purged '+rm.length+' large assets:',rm);else console.log('✅ No oversized assets found')"
scripts.build:clean: rm -rf .open-next .next node_modules/.cache && opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && node scripts/patch-cf-worker-cron.mjs
scripts.predeploy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const d='.open-next/assets';if(!fs.existsSync(d))process.exit(0);const rm=[];function walk(p){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(p)){const fp=path.join(p,f);const s=fs.statSync(fp);if(s.isDirectory())walk(fp);else if(f.endsWith('.mp4')||f.endsWith('.mov')||f.endsWith('.apk')||f.endsWith('.webm')){if(s.size>10*1024*1024||f==='demo-tutorial.mp4'){rm.push(fp);fs.unlinkSync(fp)}}}}walk(d);if(rm.length)console.log('🗑 Pre-deploy: purged '+rm.length+' large assets');else console.log('✅ Pre-deploy: no oversized assets')"
scripts.cap:android:release: bash scripts/capacitor-build.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd ..
scripts.cap:android:bundle: bash scripts/capacitor-build.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd ..
